Program Description

Welcome to the Magic: Join the Unicorn Tears Affiliate Family!

At Unicorn Tears, we believe in "magic in every drop." Our brand stands apart in the crowded skincare market by offering 100% naturally derived ingredients handcrafted in small batches. To ensure ultimate freshness and potency, every single product comes with a "born on date," so your audience knows exactly when their skincare was made.

From our Elixir Collection (featuring our powerhouse Anti-aging Peptide Cream and Serum) to our Magical Luxe Collection (including our fan-favorite Cloud Cream, Body Balm, Cleansing Balm, and Aura Lotion Candle), we provide high-performance, clean beauty that works.

Why Partner With Us?

• Generous Commissions: Get 15% commission on a new customer's first order then a 10% commission on all of their future orders. Cookie window is 30 days. We also provide a personalized 10% coupon discount for your customers to use on that first order.

Introduce other affiliates and receive a 3% commission on all of their customer's orders.

Exclusive Creator Perks: > We believe you have to feel the magic to share it! Once your application is approved, we offer tiered Product Seeding Packages based on your engagement and content style.

The Magic Tester: New partners may receive a starter kit (like our Cloud Cream) to create their first "Born on Date" unboxing.

The Luxe Experience: High-engagement creators may be eligible for our full Magical Luxe skincare or Home & Aura Collection.

Performance Rewards: We love to celebrate your success! Earn additional full-sized product gifts as you hit your first sales milestones.

• Unique Products: Promote high-quality, artisanal skincare that your followers won't find in big-box stores.

• Marketing Support: Access to high-quality imagery and specific brand hashtags to help your content shine.

How to Promote

We love seeing our products in action! We encourage our affiliates to share their authentic routines using:

• Video Content: Film "Get Ready With Me" (GRWM) videos or unboxing to show off the textures of our Cloud Cream and Balms.

• Social Posts: Share the benefits of clean, small-batch ingredients on Instagram, TikTok, or Pinterest.

• Reviews: Write honest blog posts or guides about the Elixir Collection’s anti-aging benefits.

Help us spread the magic of fresh, natural skincare. We can't wait to see what you create!
payout_period: Quarterly on the 15th of every month.
